# Office Wahala

> Office Wahala is a free browser arcade game about surviving a Nigerian workday. Players dodge their boss (Oga), "quick" meetings, deadlines and NEPA power cuts while collecting salary. It was built in Lagos by Mmadubuko Micheal, CEO of Analaize Limited, and released in October 2026. It needs no download or sign-up, runs on phones and computers, works offline after the first visit, and supports English and Nigerian Pidgin.

Key facts:
- Price: free. No ads in gameplay apart from optional sponsor billboards; no real-money purchases; the in-game naira wallet is pretend money.
- Play at: https://officewahala.netlify.app/
- Controls: arrow keys or WASD on a computer; drag one finger on a phone. E uses a saved power-up; B is the boss key (turns the game into a fake spreadsheet); Space pauses.
- Each shift starts with a 15-second Lagos commute (okadas, kekes, danfos, potholes, agberos). Arriving late costs a life.
- Office time starts at 8:00am; every 20 seconds is one office hour and one level.
- Bosses: Oga (level 2, costs two lives), MD's driver (level 3), HR lady with homing query letters (level 4), Aunty from Accounts who freezes salary pickups (level 5).
- Shift events: Salary week, Audit, Oga is travelling, AGM day, Bank alert.
- Modes: normal shift, daily shift (same pattern for everyone each day), career mode (Monday to Friday goals ending in a promotion letter), challenge links and private office leagues (weekly or tournament, with rules set by the creator: shift length, tries, same office for everyone, upgrades on or off, prize).
- Badges level up forever (Bronze to Diamond and beyond); weekly challenges every Monday; shift events include staff birthday contributions, rainy season floods, visitor from HQ, generator fuel, Owambe Friday, network down, "alert never land", 4:59pm deadline, harmattan, Independence Day, Detty December and Valentine's Day.
- Office leagues also have ghost runs, an office wall with ready-made lines and reactions, and small lunch-money gifts (pretend money).
- Promotions transfer the player to new offices, each with its own boss and hazards: Lagos ad agency, Bank HQ in Marina (ATM queues), a federal ministry in Abuja (protocol convoys), an oil and gas company in Port Harcourt (falling hard hats, gas-leak gusts) and a Yaba tech startup (surprise stand-ups).
- Every long shift has mini-missions and a 5pm emergency meeting where the boss throws agenda papers for 20 seconds.
- Coming back: a daily attendance register (₦100 to ₦1,000, one missed day forgiven), free monthly seasons with 12 reward tiers, collectible sticker sets (never sold), a desk to decorate that league colleagues can view, State Wars (36 states + FCT, weekly) and a ₦1,000 invite bonus. Optional reminders run on the device only. None of it needs an account.
- Home Wahala (second game on the same page): a day at home with an African mum. She chases you with her slipper and the broom, counts to three, sends you on errands (fetch water, buy bread and bring back the change, return the wrong item, wash the plates) and expects you to greet visiting aunties and refuse their money while she is watching. Big sister reports you, Mama Ngozi next door stops you for gist, Grandma protects you, Daddy ends the day. Office Wahala is closed on Saturdays and Sundays (Lagos time); Home Wahala is open every day. Home Wahala has its own private leagues (open every day, unlike office leagues, which pause at weekends) and an orange share card. Guide: https://officewahala.netlify.app/home-wahala/
- Staff shop: upgrades, hairstyles, accessories, free skin tones, 16 outfits, job titles. Soundtrack: six original Afrobeats, Amapiano and highlife-style songs generated in code.
- Weekly leaderboards: every normal Office Wahala or Home Wahala shift counts toward that week's public top players board (resets Monday); top players can be credited with prizes.
- Trophy badges: players who have won a cup prize or weekly leaderboard credit show a trophy next to their name on every board and the winners page; a gold trophy with a number counts first-place wins.
- Richest lists: "richest staff" (Office Wahala) and "richest kid" (Home Wahala) rank players by in-game naira balance, for all Nigeria or by state.
- Weekly Cup: a free weekly tournament with real prizes (bank transfer, airtime, gift cards, vouchers). Each cup is for one game: an Office Cup runs Monday to Friday, a Home Cup every day. The organiser can edit, pause, resume or end a cup early from the dashboard; a paused cup keeps its board but takes no new runs. Best single score wins; winners claim on WhatsApp with a private code; results and payment status are public at https://officewahala.netlify.app/winners/ (rules: https://officewahala.netlify.app/cup-rules/). Cups can be sponsored by brands; anyone can share a cup image with a direct link.
- Install: one tap on Android (Install app); on iPhone open in Safari, tap Install on iPhone and follow the three steps (Share, Add to Home Screen, Add).
- Privacy: no cookies; progress stays on the player's device; optional anonymous gameplay statistics.
- Developer contact: +234 706 645 9689 (phone/WhatsApp), https://www.analaize.com.ng
